sources.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production jigsaw clean background,portrait4:5,1280x1600. A fern-lined stream winding around smooth mossy stones, gently elevated three-quarter view. TURQUOISE water occupies the majority of the composition from upper-center to the wide foreground, contrasting emerald and sage ferns, warmgray steppingstones and small dappled sunlight patches. A detailed warm dimensional storybook digital painting, softly brushed but crisp local objects and tangible moss/stone/water textures, peaceful generic travel nature scene, no city or landmark, no lettering, UI orborder. Full canvas beautiful finished painting. Small pebbles visible under clear turquoise water. This is a clean plate for five independently painted foreground details: leave out one foreground fern tip, one right-bank reed cluster, two small drifting fallen leaves and one isolated surface glint; paint complete background water/rock behind them. Natural anchors: a low fernbase on the left bank near(15%,72%) without its frontmost frond; rightbank soil at(82%,52%) has a small reedbase; calm waterpatches at(39%,60%),(61%,78%),(49%,40%) contain no drifting leaf/glint. Keep plenty of irregular streambed detail for interesting puzzlepieces, no large featureless gradient. No photographic collage and no flat vector graphics.
